name: questportal-plugins
description: Quest Portal plugins for tabletop roleplaying: the authenticated Quest Portal MCP connection, guest character sheets for Call of Cthulhu, Pendragon and D&D, and the Battlemap pilot.

plugins.name: call-of-cthulhu-plugin
plugins.description: Create a Call of Cthulhu 7e investigator and play the horror tabletop roleplaying game.

plugins.name: pendragon-plugin
plugins.description: Create a Pendragon 6e knight, roll opposed checks and damage, and revise the sheet between adventures.

plugins.name: quest-portal-battlemap
plugins.description: Create and run persistent tactical encounters with ChatGPT control, movement, fog, and opponent turns.

plugins.name: dnd-plugin
plugins.description: Create a Dungeons & Dragons character, roll for damage and attacks, and revise the sheet as you play.

plugins.name: questportal-plugin
plugins.description: Connect your Quest Portal account to manage campaigns, notes, characters, scenes and music, and read session history and accessible library sources.
